description: This Java source file defines the RuleParameterInfo class, which encapsulates information about a parameter used in a logic rule within the OpenMRS system. It includes properties such as parameter class, whether the parameter is required, and a default value.

classes.name: RuleParameterInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata about a parameter passed to a logic rule, including its type, whether it is required, and its default value.
